## Flagship Engineering Project 1: Agentic Co-Worker Platform

- **Core Vision**: Building the future-ready digital working taskforce—an autonomous, highly specialized synthetic workforce that operates 24/7 alongside human engineering teams to eliminate toil, accelerate incident resolution, and ensure enterprise resilience.
- **Key Architecture & Capabilities**:
  - **100+ Core Digital Workers** spanning 15 IT specializations with distinct personas and operational expertise.
  - **Central Brain Orchestration**: Intelligent event routing and multi-worker coordination via EventBus (40+ operational event types, 99.99% delivery guarantee).
  - **Deep Enterprise Integrations**: ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, Control-M, MongoDB Atlas, and Gmail API for a unified source of truth.
  - **Model Context Protocol (MCP) & A2A Messaging**: Standardized tool interoperability and 5 formal collaboration protocols (Delegate, Ask, Escalate, Inform, Handoff).
  - **LangGraph State Machines**: Deterministic remediation workflows with SAFE/RESTRICTED action classification, dry-run simulations, and automated rollbacks.
  - **Semantic Memory (ChromaDB)**: High-dimensional vector store learning from historical incident patterns; 60% of new incidents resolved from known solutions.
  - **Real-Time Visibility & Voice (Jarvis)**: Hands-free voice assistant and high-throughput WebSocket streaming UI for live worker telemetry and metrics.
  - **Measured Outcomes**: Reduces MTTR by 70%, alert noise by 80%, shift handoffs from 2 hours to 5 minutes, and CAB approval from 4 hours to 5 minutes.
- **Tech Stack**: LangGraph, Google Gemini LLM, Model Context Protocol (MCP), ChromaDB, Python, WebSockets, ServiceNow REST APIs, Control-M, MongoDB Atlas.

## Flagship Engineering Project 3: RCA-Agent

- **Core Vision**: AI-Powered Root Cause Analysis System for Production Incidents. Bridges operational telemetry with LLM reasoning to automate causal diagnostics and action recommendations.
- **Key Architecture & Capabilities**:
  - **Automated Multi-Step RCA Workflow**: Orchestrates ingestion, historical vector search, causal reasoning, diagnostic report generation, and remediation recommendations.
  - **ChromaDB Vector Retrieval**: RAG pipeline indexing historical incident tickets, post-mortem reviews, error signatures, and operational runbooks.
  - **Gemini Reasoning & Embeddings**: High-dimensional embeddings and structured reasoning with strict output schema enforcement to guarantee zero hallucinations.
  - **Asynchronous Flask API**: High-throughput background analysis queue handling heavy production logs, alert payloads, and system metrics.
  - **Interactive Web Diagnostics UI**: Real-time visualization for operators to trigger incident analysis and inspect step-by-step hypothesis verification.
  - **Unified Ingestion Pipeline**: Ingestion of multi-source operational datasets across incidents, logs, runbooks, and recent deployment change records.
- **Tech Stack**: Google Gemini LLM, ChromaDB RAG, Flask Asynchronous API, Python, Vector Embeddings, Log Analytics, React Web UI.

## Flagship Engineering Project 4: TicketWave

- **Core Vision**: A Production-Grade Travel and Event Ticket Booking Platform. Built as a modular monolith to handle the complete ticketing lifecycle from discovery and seat selection to payment, confirmation, cancellation, and automated refunds.
- **Key Architecture & Capabilities**:
  - **Three-Layer Double-Booking Defense**: Combines Redisson atomic distributed locks (Lua scripts) → Redis temporary seat holds (10-minute TTL) → PostgreSQL unique constraints & row-level locks (@Version) for 100% collision-free reservations.
  - **Idempotent Operations & Safe Retries**: Webhook-driven payment processing with cryptographic signature verification and mutation idempotency keys.
  - **Dynamic Demand Pricing Engine**: Algorithmic three-tier pricing model (1.0x Base, 1.5x Surge, 1.8x Peak) dynamically calculated on live seat inventory.
  - **Sub-100ms Booking Latency**: Database query batching (reduced booking confirmation from 15 queries to 3, a 5x speedup) and HikariCP connection pooling.
  - **Full Audit Trail & Compliance**: Comprehensive audit logging of all state transitions (user ID, IP, correlation ID, state deltas) ensuring SOC 2 and GDPR readiness.
  - **Modular Monolith Design**: Clean domain boundaries (Booking, Inventory, Payment, User) structured for seamless microservice extraction without initial distributed transaction overhead.
- **Tech Stack**: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7 with Redisson, React 18, Vite 5, Tailwind CSS, Spring Security 6, JWT, Docker, Prometheus, Grafana.
- **Repository Link**: https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/TicketWave

## Flagship Engineering Project 5: SmartDesk AI

- **Core Vision**: Intelligent Multi-Agent Incident Management Platform. An agentic IT incident triage and resolution system powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash and ChromaDB vector search to automate ServiceNow incident routing and resolution.
- **Key Architecture & Capabilities**:
  - **Multi-Agent Coordination**: Specialized agents including Classification Agent (few-shot intent analysis), Resolver Agent (step-by-step fix formulation), and Synthetic Incident Generator.
  - **Vector Knowledge Base (RAG)**: ChromaDB with cosine similarity on \`all-MiniLM-L6-v2\` embeddings indexing 25+ domain KB playbooks across Network, IAM, Database, Cloud, Hardware, and Security.
  - **Intelligent Routing & Thresholds**: Automatic team routing across 8 specialist teams based on confidence: Auto-assign (≥80%), Suggest team (50-79%), or Fallback triage (<50%) with round-robin load distribution.
  - **ServiceNow Native Sync**: Bi-directional integration via REST APIs and webhooks; 30-second polling cycle with automated posting of AI work notes and resolution steps.
  - **Continuous Feedback Loop**: Human-in-the-loop correction mechanism that updates embedding representations upon operator adjustments, systematically eliminating misclassifications.
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3.12, Flask, Google Gemini 2.0 Flash (Vertex AI), LangChain 0.3, ChromaDB, ServiceNow REST API, Docker, Docker Compose.
- **Repository Link**: https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/SmartDesk-Ai

Enables organizations to deploy, manage, and orchestrate fleets of specialized AI agents with intelligent automation, enterprise knowledge retrieval, and scalable workflow orchestration through a secure, production-ready architecture.

  - **Tool Calling & Integration**: Agents trigger external tools and APIs, execute SQL queries, send notifications/emails, and update CRM/ERP records across enterprise software.
  - **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)**: LangGraph interrupt nodes requiring explicit manager approvals for high-stakes, sensitive, or destructive actions with configurable approval workflows.

## Flagship Engineering Project 7: Multi-Agent Enterprise AI Assistant

- **Core Vision**: Enterprise-Grade Multi-Agent Platform & Hybrid RAG Engine. Solves the vulnerabilities of single-prompt LLMs when tackling complex multi-step workflows by orchestrating 7 autonomous micro-agents in concurrent, stateful LangGraph channels with hybrid Reciprocal Rank Fusion, isolated serverless Python code execution, and 256-bit JWT authentication with 16 granular RBAC permissions.
- **Key Architecture & Capabilities**:
  - **7 Autonomous Micro-Agents**: Supervisor-Planner topology with 7 domain workers (Supervisor/Planner, Document Research, Code Sandbox, Data Analytics, Visualization, RBAC Guard, Audit Verifier) operating across stateful LangGraph channels.
  - **Dual-Retriever Hybrid RAG Engine**: Combines BM25 sparse keyword matching with ChromaDB 1024-dimension dense embeddings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (\`RRF_Score(d) = Σ [1 / (60 + Rank_sparse(d)) + 1 / (60 + Rank_dense(d))]\`) for verifiable paragraph citations and zero document hallucination.
  - **Serverless Python Code Execution Sandbox**: Isolated subprocess runtime with strict resource limits (5.0s CPU timeout, 256MB memory cap), running safe in-memory Pandas transformations and generating real-time Matplotlib charts.
  - **Enterprise Security & 16 Granular Permissions**: 256-bit JWT authentication, 16 granular RBAC permissions, 6 synthetic persona presets (Admin, Research, Analyst, Operator, Auditor, Guest), and an immutable security audit trail table recording cryptographic hashes of all events.
  - **Modern Cinematic UX & PWA**: 60fps Framer Motion parallax storytelling, offline-ready standalone PWA, dark/light glassmorphic UI, and search-optimized JSON-LD schemas.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, FastAPI, Python 3.12, LangGraph, LangChain, ChromaDB, BM25, SQLite, SQLAlchemy.
- **Repository Link**: https://github.com/Sonu-Thomas-001/Multi-Agent-Enterprise-AI-Assistant
